name: Shi Ling
source:
The protagonist played by the player has the ability to see the soul of the dead, but he has always felt that this ability is useless. It was not until a chance to help his childhood sweetheart solve a criminal case that he realized that this ability can be used in detective work... .

[From [url=https://polyxyz.itch.io/vision-ghost-prologue]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
玩家扮演的主角拥有看到死者灵魂的能力，但他一直觉得这个能力没什么用。直到一次帮助青梅竹马侦破刑事案件的机会，他才意识到这种能力可以用在侦探工作上……

[来自[url=https://polyxyz.itch.io/vision-ghost-prologue]Itch.io[/url]]
